content: Market Intelligence Framework for Aiguille Tools & Edges ABSTRACT： This thesis presents a comprehensive market intelligence framework designed to support Aiguille Tools & Edges in strategically navigating the competitive landscapes of security tools and Ground Engaging Tools (GET) for the mining industry. Tender Portals Overview In the digital age, the initial discovery of procurement opportunities has largely migrated from traditional print publications to specialized online tender portals. This overview of the "where" of tendering naturally leads to a more focused look at the "who"—the major mining companies and their specific procurement programs. Mining Companies with Procurement Programs While general tender portals provide a broad overview of opportunities, securing a foothold in the lucrative mining sector requires a more focused approach targeting the specific procurement programs of major mining corporations. These global giants—such as BHP, Rio Tinto, Vale, Glencore, and Anglo American—represent the largest consumers of Ground Engaging Tools (GET) and related industrial supplies. Critics would argue that these high-level signals are too abstract to be actionable and that resources are better spent on "bottom-up" intelligence gathering, such as talking directly to customers and sales teams who have more immediate and specific insights. The argument is that top-down analysis is an academic exercise with little practical value for driving day-to-day sales.
